definitions.explanation: A substance that triggers an immune response in the body, causing the production of antibodies. Commonly encountered in the context of medical testing and vaccines.

examples.japanese: {抗原|こうげん}{検査|けんさ}を{受|う}けた。
{抗原|こうげん}が{体内|たいない}に{入|はい}ると、{免疫|めんえき}{反応|はんのう}が{起|お}きる。
examples.english: When an antigen enters the body, an immune response occurs.

examples.japanese: {薬局|やっきょく}で{抗原|こうげん}{検査|けんさ}キットを{購入|こうにゅう}して、{自宅|じたく}で{検査|けんさ}した。
examples.english: I bought an antigen test kit at the pharmacy and tested at home.

notes:
USAGE:
Became widely known during the COVID-19 pandemic through {抗原|こうげん}{検査|けんさ} (antigen test). The term is now familiar to most Japanese speakers.

NOTE: A homophone of {高原|こうげん} (plateau, highland).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抗原|こうげん}{検査|けんさ} (antigen test)
- {抗原|こうげん}{検査|けんさ}キット (antigen test kit)
- {抗原|こうげん}{陽性|ようせい} (antigen positive)

RELATED WORDS:
- {抗体|こうたい}: antibody
- {免疫|めんえき}: immunity
- PCR{検査|けんさ}: PCR test
